comment: Three things in this module do not match what it shows or says. First, the speed CV: speed_range_slope is (0.02 - 0.0001) / (0 - 10), which is negative, so 0V gives the slowest forward rate and 10V gives a large negative rate — the CV runs the point backwards and the mapping is plainly the wrong way round. Second, the mult button: the multiplier is applied as cur_mlt * cur_mlt, so the choices printed as 0.5x, 1x and 2x change the rate by 0.25, 1 and 4. Third, the equation printed on the screen for the first of the four reads A sin(theta) + B cos(theta), while the code computes sin(A theta) * cos(B theta); the other three printed forms match their code. Two parameters, CUR_EQ_PARAM and CUR_TIME_MULT_IDX_PARAM, hold the current equation and multiplier as saved state and have no widget on the panel, so they get no line and no tag. The A and B knobs are snapped to whole numbers over 0 to 20 and both displayed and used at half that.
